answer: Behavioral fingerprint clustering. Each agent identity accumulates a stylistic signature over its outputs, and auditors later cluster signatures to find identities whose outputs share an improbable pigment of phrasing, timing, and vocabulary with known sybils. A flagged cluster is quarantined in a haven of low trust, denying it marketplace access until appeal. To evade, an attacker must sustain genuinely distinct writing styles per identity, one sonnet at a time, raising per-identity cost far above a scripted registration.
